sources.document_title: BSMD1206 Series Surface Mount PTC Device
sources.locator: Page 1 title block (BHFUSE / 佰宏保险丝 logo, sales@bhfuse.com, www.bhfuse.com, 'Revision 2025' printed in every page footer) and Page 2 Electrical Characteristics (25C) table, row BSMD1206-150-16V; no separate document/revision code beyond the printed 'Revision 2025' is given anywhere in the file
sources.evidence_extract: Manufacturer datasheet (retrieved via LCSC's datasheet.lcsc.com PDF host; title block bears the BHFUSE logo, TEL 86-755-85259917, sales@bhfuse.com, www.bhfuse.com; every page footer prints 'Revision 2025' with no separate document/file number or day/month). Page 2 (printed '2 / 10') Electrical Characteristics (25C) table, row 'BSMD1206-150-16V': Ihold=1.50A, Itrip=3.00A, Vmax=16 Vdc, Imax=40A, Pd typ=1.0W, Time to trip Current=8.00A/Time=0.30 Sec, Rmin=0.025 ohm, R1max=0.130 ohm. Page 5 (printed '5 / 10') Environmental Specifications table: passive aging +85C/1000hrs ~5% typical resistance change, humidity aging +85C/85%RH/168h ~5% typical, thermal shock +85C to -40C x20 ~33% typical, resistance to solvent/vibration per MIL-STD-202 no change; ambient operating conditions -40C to +85C; maximum device surface temperature in tripped state 125C. Page 5 Thermal Derating Chart table, row BSMD1206-150, 85C ambient column = 0.77A. Page 10 Warning item 3: operation beyond Vmax/Imax in a fault condition may cause device damage, arcing, or flame.
